cases.rationale: The two rows share an explicit release-record-retention context and require incompatible retention versus deletion periods.
The requirements use different wording but express the same two-approval-before-deployment rule.
Emergency deployment and urgent operations are not shown to be the same scope; a context-missing candidate must not be scored as an asserted conflict.
A 90-day retention period and 90-day availability deadline concern different record actions and do not conflict.

limitations: This version contains four curated cases over two synthetic source documents.
The cases do not establish model quality, population-level recall, precision, or false-positive rates.
Expected outcomes are evaluation-only and must not be included in provider input.
The catalog supports offline deterministic fixture simulation and does not authorize provider execution.
